title: Unit Event — THE POWER OF UNITY — Episode6 Fluffy Pancakes

meta.Event Outline: As Akito repeatedly watches the video of RAD WEEKEND, he realizes that creating a certain "atmosphere" may be the key to surpassing the legend. Then, he hears that Len and the others are going to put on an event in SEKAI.

rows.Line: The next day
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hello... Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
MEIKO!
Can I put the speaker here?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes! Just be careful, okay?
Luka, mind helping him carry it?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, ma'am♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, I just rolled out the mic cable, so please watch your step...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
W-W-Wah!
I'm all tangled up!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, I caught a Rin...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Looks like their preparations are going pretty smoothly...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, they are... As much as I'd like to help, we may just end up getting in the way because of all these things. We may want to do something else and wait until things settle down...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hello, everyone!
How've you been?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wah! KAITO!
Don't scare us like that...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, KAITO, aren't you supposed to be helping them...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I was! They said that I could sit back and relax after I got all of my DJ equipment set up!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Doesn't that kinda mean they didn't want him around any longer than necessary...?)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Anyway, how's your event coming along? Everything going okay...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, about that...
Things haven't been going like we imagined and wanted to ask you guys for some advice.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, really?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Everyone we got on board's really good, so we should be ready to go forward with our event...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But we're nowhere close to getting the atmosphere we want...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Atmosphere...?
You mean that thing you mentioned the other day?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah.
I know we're not gonna recreate it right off the bat, but we're so far from it... No hints as to what to do either...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is this about Tono...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, you knew...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. I noticed you looking his way a few times, so I began to wonder if something was on your mind.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. He's got talent and has given us plenty of good advice...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I can't figure out what's going through his head...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: He takes our practices seriously, but he's suddenly left a few times already and it always seems like there's something bothering him...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I understand what you mean, Akito...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Compared to before, the current Tono seems less focused... Almost like he's always looking somewhere else...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, I know!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
What should we do...? Huh?
Where'd KAITO go...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hm? Oh, he's gone.
When did that happen...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, he's rummaging around the freezer!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Let's see... Ice cream...
Aha! This one looks delicious!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hold up...!
You're gonna eat ice cream at a time like this?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Huh?
No, wait! You're getting the wrong idea!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
How am I getting the wrong idea?
It definitely looks like you're about to eat that.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: No, I really mean it!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: All of you, especially Akito, seem to have a lot on your minds, so I thought I'd make you some pancakes a la mode to help you relax a little! They say your brain needs sugar to keep going, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Pancakes?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I didn't know you could do that, KAITO...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Of course I can!
I'm actually pretty good at it too. I'm even right behind MEIKO in terms of brewing coffee!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I had no idea...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's actually pretty cool!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sorry for getting the wrong idea. I didn't realize you were doing this for us...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Haha. All good!
It probably doesn't help that I was caught red-handed once eating Rin and everyone else's ice cream...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh...
This situation could also apply to that Tono person you were talking about earlier.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Huh?
What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: How you may be getting the wrong idea. Based on what I heard just now, their resolve seems fairly strong on top of being very talented...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: All the while they may have a lot on their mind, like you guys. What if something's really bothering them?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Something bothering him...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, that could be the case.
As talented as Tono is, he's not exactly a perfect human being.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Do you think this has anything to do with why he hasn't been in many events lately?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... Or is losing to Uncle Taiga still eating away at him?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But he doesn't seem like that soft a person...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You may want to sit down and discuss that.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Once you reach an understanding... Yes, you'll all surely become a delicious batch of pancakes!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: P-Pancakes...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
That's right!
You aren't guaranteed to end up with delicious pancakes just because you gathered up some good ingredients!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You have to mix the batter well and cook them right to get them to be nice and fluffy.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I believe events are no different. It can only become good after you've all mixed together and reach an understanding with one another.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: An understanding with one another, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We were convinced that we'd have to essentially compete against each other. It never crossed our minds to try and reach any sort of understanding.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, understanding one another would make it easier for us to all work together. That's the same for basketball or any other team sport!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right. Getting to understand each other is bound to make our event even better.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Exactly!
That's why I think it'd be good for all of you to get to know this Tono person and the other performers better.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, that's definitely worth giving a shot...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Thanks, KAITO.
We'll try everything that we can.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wonderful! I wish you the best of luck!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Now, how do some freshly made pancakes sound?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow! They look so yummy!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They were actually supposed to look much fluffier, but I just couldn't get them to rise more...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. MEIKO said how mixing the batter overzealously will prevent them from becoming nice and fluffy.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Luckily, these turned out beautifully! Hah hah hah!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Why do I not feel reassured by that...?
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Man, I'm so glad we did this today!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The pancakes KAITO made were so good too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah... Anyway, we really gotta get moving starting tomorrow. We need to find a way to get on the same page as Tono, as well as Mita, Okazaki and the others.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah!
L-Let's do our best!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: For now, let's call it a day and get some rest.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay, nice work today!
See you guys tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Bye bye!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright...
Let's start heading home too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Okay.
Hm...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What's up, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Over there. Isn't that...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Tono...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Okay. I'll head over now...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (He's on his phone again...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But with who...?)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I believe events are no different. It can only become good after you've all mixed together and reach an understanding with one another.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya, mind if I go over to talk to him...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
After all, I'd like to make some delicious pancakes too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Says the guy who doesn't like sweets...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Tono...!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Oh, Shinonome, Aoyagi.
Were you both about to head home?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah.
We were doing some planning together.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Tono, what were you doing here just now?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Oh...
Just dealing with some things.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Do any of the calls you got the other day have anything to do with this...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You've been giving us good performances on stage and helpful advice.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But we can all tell that something's been on your mind lately.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: As fellow performers participating in the same event, we thought we should ask.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Was it that obvious?
I guess I still have a long way to go.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: The truth is, I was about to go visit my partner at the hospital just over that way.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Your partner? Hang on...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What happened to this “partner” of yours?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: They're far away in a different city now...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: In a different city? So you're not performing together? Don't they want to surpass RAD WEEKEND too?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: They can't sing anymore. Not after the accident...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Accident...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: A traffic accident. This car ran through an intersection and...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Well, they lived, but some parts of their body became paralyzed. Singing was no longer really possible.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Wait, the hospital just over there...?
What happened to them being somewhere far away?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Originally, he was.
But he was desperate to come back and started feeling a little better recently, so he got permission to transfer.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Transfer?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Yes. After discussing the matter at length and realizing that his parents would be too busy with work, I decided to help him with the transfer process.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: He wants to be as close as he can to this city it seems...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Oh...
Why don't you join me?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: He loves listening to music by everyone from Vivid Street. He's starting to get bored of me going on about myself, so I'd like it if you could tell him some fun stories.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Would you mind...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Okay, I'll go...
How about you, Toya...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Alright, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Tono's partner...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (What's he gonna be like...?)
